title: CARTOGRAFFECT®: Unified Research Compendium — Hexa-Prover Formal Verification, Theory & Active Inference Benchmarks
description: CARTOGRAFFECT® v2.0.1 stratified Research Compendium. Strate 0 integrates six independent formal proof suites (Lean 4.35.0, Rocq 9.0, Agda 2.9.0, Dafny 4.11.0, SMT-LIB 2.6 / Z3 5.3.3, TLA+/TLC 2.19) certifying 113/113 theorems with 0 sorry / 0 custom axioms, the isomorphic exact integer Python predictive engine, and the canonical theoretical manuscript (docs/01-Article_Cartograffect.md, 176 affective states on Z in {0,...,7}, predictions P1-P5). Strate 1 hosts subordinate exploratory extensions for affective lexical projection and psychometric benchmarks (extensions/lexicon/) and Active Inference pymdp/JAX/NumPyro generative simulations (extensions/in_silico/).
